senses.gloss: liṅgita (nt.; = Skt. āliṅgita, perhaps to be adopted here by em., but forms of liṅg-, without ā-, seem to be reported, tho rarely, from Skt., see BR; Pali, as liṅgiya, Therīg. 〔398〕, comm. āliṅgetvā; and Pkt., see Sheth), embrace: -capeṭa-liṅgita-cumbita- etc. Laṅk 〔119.14〕; all erotic practices; Suzuki, absurdly, suggesting!
